title: News and recommended crates API
description:
Create services/news.ts and routes/news.ts: public GET /api/news returns newsItem[], published_at desc then id desc, publishedAt as ISO via toISOString; the seed_key is not exposed. Register `newsRoutes` under /api in app.ts.

Add `listRecommendedCrates(db)` to services/crates.ts: crates with recommended_rank not null, inner join owner, left join albums for albumCount, order by rank then id, mapped to crateCard (no ownerId, no demo key). Add public GET /crates/recommended to routes/crates.ts, response crateCard.array(); it must resolve ahead of /crates/:id. Existing /crates shapes do not change.

Tests: test/news.test.ts and test/recommended.test.ts use buildTestApp, assert empty arrays before seeding, then call seedDemoContent(app.db) from services/demo-seed.ts and assert: 200 without a cookie, news length >= 6 with fields and newest-first sort; recommended length >= 6, every crate albumCount >= 4 with owner username and display name, none named Guitars or Beats & Bass even when those exist, no key ownerId/email/role. Extend the it.each in test/web.test.ts with /following, /profile, /about, /shelf and /crates/5, and keep the /api 404 JSON check.

In-memory databases only; never touch data/.
